title: Rank-Constrained Adaptation for Reliable Real-World Performance
abstract: arXiv:2602.06924v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning models trained to optimize average accuracy often exhibit systematic failures on particular subpopulations. In real-world settings like healthcare, the subpopulations most affected by such disparities are frequently unlabeled, partially observed, or not known in advance. Existing group-robust methods typically assume prior knowledge of the relevant subgroups, using group annotations for training, validation, or model selection. We propose Misclassification Aware Rank-Limited Adaptation (MARLA), a parameter-efficient method for improving worst group performance without explicit subgroup annotations. MARLA leverages an ERM-trained model by calculating the model's misclassification probability scores on a held-out adaptation set to identify a low-dimensional subspace where errors concentrate. translated_title: 面向可靠现实世界表现的秩约束自适应
translated_abstract: 旨在优化平均准确率而训练的深度学习模型，往往会在特定子群体上出现系统性失败。在医疗保健等现实场景中，受此类差异影响最大的子群体通常是无标签的、部分可观测的，或事先未知的。现有的群体鲁棒性方法通常假设事先知晓相关子群体，在训练、验证或模型选择中使用群体标注。我们提出了误分类感知秩受限自适应，这是一种无需显式子群体标注即可提升最差群体表现的参数高效方法。MARLA 利用一个经 ERM（经验风险最小化）训练的模型，在留出的自适应集上计算模型的误分类概率得分，从而识别出误差集中的低维子空间；随后在该子空间内学习对分类器 logits 的秩受限加性修正。在七个真实世界数据集上……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出 MARLA，一种无需子群体标注的参数高效自适应方法，通过在误分类集中的低维子空间内学习秩受限的 logits 加性修正来提升模型的最差群体表现。
en_tdlr: MARLA is a parameter-efficient adaptation method that improves worst-group performance without subgroup annotations by learning a rank-restrained additive correction to classifier logits within a low-dimensional subspace where errors concentrate.
